scope: One attempt initially awaiting_edit; two finishers; six finite currentness/verdict observations; no reset or new attempt.
atomicity: The existing commit_manifest_locked recheck/write is abstracted as one atomic transition. TLC does not prove the lock or filesystem.
currentness: Captured after-phase currentness only, not a universal verification bit or later receipt currentness. Real source/head/edit-cage checks are abstracted inputs.
environment: Trusted local Java runtime and official digest-pinned TLC jar; recorded version is observation, not execution attestation.
liveness: No fairness assumptions, liveness theorem, real-time bound, or unbounded-worker claim.
implementation: Existing production classifier, two-finisher race and post-finish drift tests are separate obligations. Passing this model alone does not execute those tests or prove Rust refinement.
controls: The three known-wrong configs change only one model switch each. They retain every original invariant and must produce the named native safety counterexample.
